notes: errorRate = transport failures + 5xx; non2xxRate also counts 4xx (rate limits, coded refusals).

mock RPC answers simulateTransaction cleanly and serves a flat taker account for MOCK_OWNER: build requests run the whole build path (reads, caps, LP selection, simulations) and measure the API's own cost, not the program or a real RPC's latency. Builds draw on the global build budget (300 per minute), so an unpaced run is mostly 429 on builds; pace with --rps to measure served builds.
